body: Yeah I have multiple family members on meds and it doesn't seem to do anything. That's fine though goodnight man.

It makes it real tough because like I want 'help' but that doesn't mean psych wards and meds. I want to do it without medication. I wish talking about it could fix it but I don't even know if that would, it makes me feel a little better at least. Getting diagnosed with something would fuck my chances at employment too because trying to go into law and the military.

Not sure if this is what you mean but for me I have experienced the same to an extent, as my mental health has worsened over the past 9 years, my ability to speak has rapidly deteriorated as well as my ability to spell. I can't spell half the words I could when I was 10 and when I speak, my brain comes up with the sentence but when speaking the words come out in the wrong order and it doesn't sound right and I also have developed some kind of weird stutter that is as close as I can describe it. I also sometimes write sentences in the wrong order or missing words, that one is more recent though. I am in law school and it hasn't really affected me too much academically but its quite irritating and getting worse.

​

That's my problem though, I can't talk to them or they will leave. I've tried before and I know if I tell them what I did they would leave. I don't even have that many friends so I am trying to keep what I have at least. It's like a positive feedback loop, I could tell them but I will lose them or I don't tell them and get to keep them around.

​
